new_value: HAL GNSS/location/time snapshots are fully implemented. The hal.h header defines comprehensive snapshot structures (lichen_hal_location_time_snapshot with lat/lon, altitude, accuracy, satellites, fix time, age, source class, fix state; lichen_hal_time_snapshot with unix_time, source class, age, accuracy, quality, epoch floor). hal_location.c and hal_time.c implement multi-source arbitration with priority ordering (manual > local client > network > external HW > onboard HW), staleness detection, and epoch floor validation. hal_bridge.c bridges these snapshots to the app interface for Meshtastic compatibility. The gnss_ag3335.c driver supports hardware GNSS. Extensive tests in lichen/tests/hal/src/main.c cover all snapshot behaviors.
